comment: Advisory performance budget (design §19.2 item 1, docs/performance.md): ci/bench-report.py warns when a result exceeds one and never fails the job. Set on 2026-10-13 from the first CI run (GitHub ubuntu-latest, 4 CPUs, loop filesystems) at about 1.5 to 2 times the slower filesystem's result, so runner noise stays under it and a real regression does not.

budgets.why: §3.2: a small file's change boundary (measured 1.3 ms XFS, 1.9 ms ext4)
group commit under concurrency (measured 5.0 ms XFS, 6.1 ms ext4)
a removal: journal append and fsync (measured 0.45 ms XFS, 0.84 ms ext4)
§3.2: a reflink does not depend on size (measured 0.44 ms)
§3.2: with reflink the step does not depend on size (measured 1.4 ms)
§3.2 through FUSE, p50 (measured 1.8 ms XFS, 2.4 ms ext4)
git clone into a recorded working tree (measured 17x XFS, 21x ext4)
small files into an excluded path (measured 17x XFS, 20x ext4)
100k small files, each recorded (measured 63x XFS, 83x ext4)
commit catch-up after 100k files (measured 483 s XFS, 474 s ext4)
rm -rf of 100k recorded files (measured 14x XFS, 50x ext4)
§3.2: reflink freeze of a clean 1 GiB file (measured 3 ms)
reflink of a dirty 1 GiB file waits for writeback (measured 2.6 s)
ext4 copies 1 GiB of dirty pages (measured 5.4 s)
